summary: lightclient 为 EIP-8141 新增 `SIGDATACOPY` 指令，把复制 `ARBITRARY` 签名数据的行为从 `SIGPARAM` 中拆出，让 `SIGPARAM` 的栈需求变成静态，当天合并；8 月 6 日提交的初始 warm 集合 PR 和 8 月 14 日的禁用操作码放宽 PR 也同日合并。chunter-cb 为 EIP-8130 提出 L1 与 L2 两种采用档位。ladislaus 提醒 Glamsterdam 后普通 ETH 转账不再总是 21,000 gas。晚上 FOCIL Breakout #40 定下 focil-devnet-0 目标 8 月 31 日。

items.topic: 原生 AA 两条路线同日推进
items.title: EIP-8141：新增 SIGDATACOPY，使 SIGPARAM 的栈需求为静态
items.note: （lightclient）提交并合并。复制 `ARBITRARY` 签名数据时 `SIGPARAM` 的栈大小是动态的，多次被指出有问题，PR 把这部分拆成单独指令。
items.title_en: EIP-8141: add SIGDATACOPY so the stack requirement for SIGPARAM is static
items.note_en: (lightclient), submitted and merged. A dynamic stack size for `SIGPARAM` when copying `ARBITRARY` sigdata had been flagged as problematic several times, so the PR splits that behavior into a separate instruction.

items.title: EIP-8130：采用档位、有界认证 gas 和时间戳归一化
items.note: （chunter-cb）提交。8130 只写一份规范，但按两种档位之一采用：L1 档位把固有 gas 表定为规范（gas 表就是规范，只能经硬分叉修改），对认证器采用宽松的接受策略。
items.title_en: EIP-8130: adoption profiles, bounded auth gas and timestamp normalization
items.note_en: (chunter-cb), submitted. 8130 is specified once but adopted under one of two profiles: the L1 profile makes the intrinsic gas schedule normative (the gas schedule is the spec, changeable only by hard fork) and uses a permissive authenticator acceptance policy.

plain transfers no longer a flat 21
summary_en: lightclient added a `SIGDATACOPY` instruction to EIP-8141, splitting the copying of `ARBITRARY` signature data out of `SIGPARAM` so that `SIGPARAM`'s stack requirement becomes static, merged the same day; the August 6 initial warm set PR and the August 14 banned-opcode relaxation were also merged. chunter-cb proposed L1 and L2 adoption profiles for EIP-8130. ladislaus warned that a plain ETH transfer is no longer always 21,000 gas after Glamsterdam. In the evening FOCIL Breakout #40 set focil-devnet-0 for August 31.
